name: Cracked Presale Code
description:
Investigators recovered a strange encrypted message while examining evidence from the Starlight Arena ticketing incident.

The message appears to contain an important presale code, but it has been encrypted using a simple cipher.

## Your Mission

1. Download `encrypted_message.txt`.
2. Examine the encrypted message.
3. Decode the message to discover the hidden presale code.
4. Submit the recovered code using this format:

`GRIFFITH{CODE}`

Example:

`GRIFFITH{EXAMPLE}`

hints.title: Hint 1: Identify the Cipher
hints.content: The encrypted message looks like each letter has been shifted by the same number of positions in the alphabet. What simple cipher uses this technique?

hints.title: Hint 2: Caesar Cipher
hints.content: This message uses a Caesar cipher. Try shifting each encrypted letter 3 positions backwards in the alphabet.
